goal: Connect the existing draft-only Growth framework to Admin and synchronize evidence, claims, unfinished work and future gates with the reviewed Nilaza source state.
successCriteria: Growth shows product evidence and limits, twelve bilingual concept drafts, measurement gaps and an actionable prioritized roadmap from canonical repository sources.
Repository readiness remains visible when live waitlist aggregates fail; synthetic counts require an explicit review action and a retry can restore the live source.
Waitlist metrics distinguish unique contact records, suppression reasons and confirmed pools from actual send eligibility; unavailable denominators never appear as zero conversion.
Updated Astrology and Tarot copy carries current evidence and pending editorial review; no automated verdict, public approval or native acceptance is invented.
Generated Growth snapshot freshness and privacy boundaries are checked alongside both existing protected Admin workspaces.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile runtime, authentication, credits, payments, profile, chart storage, chat and journal contracts retain their existing behavior.
Content Operations and AI Studio remain separate protected workspaces with their current editing and publishing authority.
Supabase RPCs, schema, migration ledger, provider configuration and production deployments remain outside this task.
Portable Growth core and cross-tenant framework exports retain their draft-only contract and private tenant boundary.

impact.entryPoint: Shared authenticated Admin shell gains Growth readiness, product truth, content drafts, measurement and roadmap routes. Existing campaign-map and delivery-health links remain; overview becomes the full Growth overview and waitlist moves to the explicit waitlist route.
impact.dataWrite: Write versioned sanitized Nilaza Growth JSON, a deterministic selected-field Admin snapshot, scoped code and documentation only; browser review makes no database or approval writes.
impact.backendContract: Keep get_growth_waitlist_overview behind overview.read with the existing RPC transport; repository snapshot loads independently after authorization; no sender or provider integration.
impact.adminVisibility: Operators can inspect actual product evidence, pending gates, localized concept copy and unmeasured event definitions; draft QA is labeled historical or awaiting editorial review rather than execution approval.
impact.privacySafety: Only approved project context and aggregate counts are used. Exclude subscriber identifiers, private chats, journals, birth/chart inputs, secrets and raw research from generated snapshots; escape untrusted text.
impact.observability: Show repository review date and source versions separately from live RPC timestamp; missing counts and events remain unavailable; surface loading, empty, malformed data and retry states without private payload logs.
impact.rollback: Revert only this task's scoped edits or retain the original waitlist routes; the new repository snapshot has no production side effects and source failures do not silently load synthetic counts.

canonicalContracts: packages/growth-nilaza/product-truth.json is the single Nilaza feature claim and evidence source; preserved claim IDs maintain existing brief references.
packages/growth-nilaza/content-drafts/sprint-01.json and briefs/sprint-01.json remain the draft library and brief source with unchanged tenant identity.
packages/growth-nilaza/operations/roadmap.json defines current operating tasks and manager acceptance; measurement/event-ownership-map.json remains definition-only.
apps/admin/generated/growth-operations.json is a deterministic selected-field projection checked by scripts/build-admin-growth.mjs --check, never a second editable source.
The existing get_growth_waitlist_overview RPC remains the capability-gated aggregate contract and does not establish send eligibility.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: The existing source protocol covers this additive Admin slice, read-only aggregate transport, generated provenance, delegation and no external actions; no durable policy exception is needed.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Growth uses current Open Reflection fonts and tokens and records verified vs released states without changing master assets or public material.

dependencyReview.evidence: No dependencies or external APIs are introduced; use current Node built-ins, existing browser modules and repository-owned RPC behavior verified in local sources.

securityReview.authzRls: Preserve overview.read and the workspace/session guard; new repository data loads only after permission checks. No RLS or protected endpoint behavior changes.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Generator selects only approved configuration and concept metadata. No audience, raw research notes, chat, journal, birth/face data or receipts enter the projection.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Never read credentials or print RPC payloads. Retain existing session transport and public configuration; snapshot tests reject unknown or private-shaped data.
securityReview.externalInput: Escape all rendered JSON strings, validate snapshot shapes, constrain selectors/routes and never turn evidence references into arbitrary URLs or runnable commands.
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency installation or provider runtime is needed; deterministic snapshot uses Node built-ins and current reviewed repository inputs.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database write, migration push/repair, deployment, public publishing, channel connection or budget mutation is performed.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop for unexpected private data, broader production authority, unresolved high risk or a broken existing workspace; update and rerun preflight before scope expands.

workingTreeReview.note: Existing dirty source is preserved; reviewed scope paths are inventoried from git before preflight. Unrelated mobile, backend and QA work is left untouched.

validationCommands: Browser QA of both protected existing workspaces and Growth routes with labeled synthetic contract data.
managerTestPath: Open Admin Growth, inspect readiness and product truth, select VI/EN and a draft to see evidence and blockers, review measurement and roadmap; then open waitlist, retry live access or explicitly select synthetic data, and verify Content Operations and AI Studio remain accessible.
residualRisk: Repository snapshots reflect dated reviewed evidence, not real-time deployment or full manager acceptance. Admin 78 tests and Growth 7 tests pass; final browser layout, accessibility and existing-workspace happy paths remain unverified because the browser debugger/Windows sandbox connection could not be restored. Sender, runtime measurement and staging deployment remain separate gates; no activation or browser acceptance is claimed.
